parameters.name: FeePackage
parameters.description:
The payable resource plan. Valid values:

- If the EnvironmentType parameter is set to CS, set the value to CS\_Basic or CS\_Pro. Default value: CS\_Basic.

- Otherwise, leave the parameter empty.
